remarks: Completely renovated 2-bedroom gem in the heart of East Norwalk! - Finished upper level for additional office space or den - Updated kitchen with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and brand new vinyl flooring! - Recessed lighting throughout + tons of natural light - High-efficiency gas heat for lower utility bills - Access to shared front and backyard, including a private back deck! - Washer/dryer in-unit - Just a short walk to the East Norwalk train station, and minutes to Calf Pasture Beach, I-95, Stew Leonard's, and all of the amenities downtown SoNo has to offer! - Off/street parking included - Additional storage space available for a fee - No pets!
